sources.title: nikskywalker/PPO-LunarLander-v2 - GitHub
sources.snippet: PPO from Scratch — LunarLander-v2 A Proximal Policy Optimization agent implemented from scratch in PyTorch, trained to solve the LunarLander-v2 environment from OpenAI Gymnasium. No external RL libraries (e.g. Stable-Baselines3) were used — the entire training loop, advantage estimation, and policy update logic are written explicitly.

sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a PPO agent playing LunarLander-v2 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
